positioning: Local-first Windows reading library with bounded publication imports, offline progress and annotations, and a least-privilege Tauri shell.

formats.epub: EPUB 2/3 reflowable reading with sanitized package content
formats.pdf: canvas page rendering, page navigation, zoom, and progress
formats.text: TXT, Markdown, and HTML reading after normalization or sanitization
formats.audio: unprotected M4B, M4A, MP3, AAC, OGG, and WAV through WebView2 codecs
formats.aax: bounded metadata only; no payload storage, activation data, decryption, conversion, or playback

trustBoundaries: Every imported file is untrusted and subject to format-specific size and structure limits.
Imported markup is allowlist-sanitized; remote and active content is removed.
PDF scripting, evaluation, XFA, and remote workers are disabled.
The WebView receives no generic shell, process, network, or broad filesystem authority.
Reader creates one native WebView window, denies popup requests, and uses single-instance focus behavior.
Reader makes no application network requests, includes no telemetry, and requires no account.
knownLimitations: IndexedDB durability and eviction are controlled by the Windows WebView2 profile; metadata export is one-way and not a restorable library backup.
PDF content is canvas-only, without a selectable text layer, document search, annotations, or complete screen-reader access.
Fixed-layout and protected EPUB, EPUB CFI locations, cross-device sync, and cloud backup are not implemented.
Audio codec behavior depends on the installed Windows WebView2 media engine.
The candidate has not completed a clean Windows 10/11 install, upgrade, uninstall, and residual-data matrix.
The installer is unsigned; no signing certificate or signing authorization has been provided.
